description: Wooroloo Bushfire 05_02_2021 (LGATE-318) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Landgate. Satellite imagery (visible spectrum) over the Wooroloo bushfire event taken at 10. 14am on 5 Feb 2021. Resampled to 1m resolution. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Landgate. Its tags are 2021, Perth, Pleiades, Wooroloo, bushfires. It offers 2 resource(s) in api arcgis server map service, wms. The portal shows 2024-08-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Custom (Other). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
